title: 第九十六章侠影留香第九十五章长安无眠
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：长安剑客萧书生贰正文第九十六章侠影留香（..la）暮春的风掠过长安朱雀大街的尽头，拐入东街狭长的街巷，卷着满地零落的杨花，软得像一场未醒的旧梦。
萧琰立在青石板路的中央，白衣纤尘不染，腰间悬着一柄无铭短剑，剑鞘是质朴的乌木质地，没有鎏金纹饰，没有珠玉点缀，只在柄尾系着一截褪色的素色丝绦，随风轻轻晃动。他抬眼望向前方绵延无尽的街巷，青砖黛瓦次第排布，飞檐翘角刺破淡青色的天幕，喧嚣人声、车马辘轳、商贩吆喝交织在一起，汇成大唐帝都最鲜活滚烫的烟火气象。
这是他阔别三年的长安。
三年前他一身青涩，携剑离京，踏遍千山万水，闯过江湖风雨，见过南疆瘴雨蛮烟，遇过关北风雪苍茫，闯过诡谲山庄纷争，化解过江湖恩怨情仇。世人皆知江湖辽阔、侠气纵横，却不知江湖路远，步步皆是风霜，件件皆有牵绊。如今归来，帝都依旧繁华鼎盛，车水马龙川流不息，可昔年同游之人早已四散天涯，旧岁恩怨深埋岁月，唯有满城春风，一如往昔，温柔如故。
东街不算帝都最繁华的街巷，比不上朱雀大街的恢弘壮阔，不及西市的商贾云集，却独有一番市井温柔与江湖底蕴。这里一半是寻常百姓的烟火日常，酒肆茶坊林立，摊铺鳞次栉比，往来多是布衣百姓、寻常旅人；一半是隐于闹市的江湖气息，偶有佩刀带剑的侠客匆匆而过，眉眼间藏着风霜，步履间带着锋芒，藏着不为人知的刀光剑影。
萧琰缓步前行，脚下青石板历经百年车马碾压、行人踏踩，温润光滑，缝隙间嵌着细碎的青苔与落花。他身姿挺拔，步履从容，没有寻常侠客的张扬凌厉，眉眼清隽温和，肤色是常年行走江湖晒出的浅淡麦色，一双眼眸澄澈深邃，看似淡然无波，却藏着阅尽世事的沉静与通透。江湖人称他“素剑客”，说他剑出无痕、侠影留香，待人温润如玉，处事磊落坦荡，可唯有他自己知晓，这身温润皮囊之下，藏着多少辗转难眠的夜晚，藏着多少不忍回望的过往。
沿街的摊铺热闹非凡。卖糖画的老者守着黄铜小炉，融化的糖稀色泽金黄，丝丝缕缕滴落，手腕翻飞间，龙凤花鸟的轮廓便栩栩如生，引得一众孩童围拢围观，叽叽喳喳的笑语清脆悦耳。对面的花摊摆满了暮春时节的繁花，牡丹雍容、蔷薇烂漫、茉莉清甜，姹紫嫣红缀满竹筐，馥郁花香随风漫溢，揉碎在温热的春风里。不远处的茶肆挂着褪色的青布幌子，随风轻摇，幌子上“清风茶舍”四个字笔力遒劲，历经风雨依旧清晰。茶肆内人声鼎沸，三教九流齐聚于此，闲谈市井琐事，热议江湖传闻，高低错落的话语声连绵不绝。
萧琰无意驻足热闹摊铺，也无心落座茶肆闲谈。他目光淡淡扫过周遭繁华，眼底掠过一丝浅淡怅然。三年光阴，倏忽而过，世间万物看似依旧，实则早已物是人非。当年他初入江湖，满腔热血，意气风发，坚信侠之大者，当惩恶扬善、匡扶正义，以为凭一柄短剑、一身孤勇，便能扫尽世间不平，护得岁岁安宁。可遍历江湖之后才渐渐懂得，江湖从非非黑即白，人心远比刀剑莫测，恩怨纠葛、利益牵绊、身不由己，从来都是江湖常态。
他行至东街中段的老槐树下，驻足而立。这棵古槐已有百年树龄，枝干虬曲苍劲，树冠繁茂如云，层层叠叠的绿叶遮天蔽日，将周遭一方天地笼入清凉。树身布满深浅不一的刻痕，是数十年往来旅人、江湖过客留下的印记，有的刻着姓名，有的刻着短句，有的只剩模糊斑驳的纹路，藏着无数无人知晓的故事。
萧琰的指尖轻轻拂过粗糙的树皮，触感微凉，带着岁月沉淀的厚重。三年前，他便是在此处与挚友道别。彼时也是暮春时节，杨花纷飞，清风拂面，两人倚着古槐，对饮薄酒，畅谈江湖理想，约定三年之后，重聚长安东街，再话平生、共叙江湖。
可如今，旧地仍在，古槐依旧，春风如故，故人却迟迟未至。
风穿过槐树叶的缝隙，簌簌作响，像是故人低语，温柔又苍凉。细碎的光斑透过枝叶洒落，落在萧琰素白的衣袍上，碎成点点金芒。他微微垂眸，眼底情绪淡得几乎看不见，无悲无喜，无念无嗔。江湖辗转三年，他早已学会释怀离别，看淡得失起落，只是重回旧地，往日点滴回忆翻涌心头，终究难免生出几分怅惘。
“客官，歇歇脚吧？刚沏好的雨前新茶，清甜解乏，一文钱一碗！”
街边茶摊的老汉见他伫立良久，身姿挺拔气质不凡，连忙笑着招呼。老汉身着粗布麻衣，面容和善，眼角布满深深的皱纹，手上端着青瓷茶碗，茶水清澈透亮，热气袅袅升腾，清甜的茶香随风飘散。
萧琰回过神来，微微颔首，轻声道谢，声音清润低沉，带着久经世事的温和疏离：“多谢老丈。”
他移步走到茶摊的木桌旁落座，木桌木椅皆是老旧物件，打磨得光滑温润，带着常年烟火浸润的温度。老汉麻利地为他斟满一碗热茶，笑着说道：“看客官这身打扮，定是行走江湖的侠客，一路风尘仆仆，辛苦了。咱长安东街，许久不见这般气度不凡的公子了。”
萧琰端起茶碗，浅啜一口。茶汤清冽甘甜，暖意顺着喉咙缓缓下沉，驱散了一路风尘的疲惫。他放下茶碗，淡然一笑，并未多言。行走江湖多年，他早已习惯陌生人的善意寒暄，也习惯了沉默自持，不愿轻易袒露过往心事。
老汉见他不欲多言，也不刻意攀谈，只是一边擦拭桌椅，一边絮絮闲谈市井琐事、街巷传闻。从东街商铺的兴衰更替，说到帝都近日的风物变迁，再随口聊起近期江湖流传的动静，话语质朴，烟火气息十足。
“近来长安城里不太平啊。”老汉压低声音，神色间带着几分忌惮，“城东近来频发失窃案，失窃的不是金银珠宝，皆是各家珍藏的武学残页、奇门兵器，寻常官府查不出半点头绪，市井间都传，是隐秘江湖门派潜入帝都，暗中搜罗武学秘宝，图谋不轨。”
萧琰指尖微顿，眼底掠过一丝浅淡锋芒，转瞬又归于平静。

他遍历江湖，深知帝都看似繁华安稳，实则暗流涌动。朝堂势力纠葛不休，江湖门派盘根错节，正邪之争、利益博弈从未停歇。长安作为帝都中枢，龙蛇混杂，各方势力蛰伏潜藏，看似太平盛世，暗地里早已风起云涌。寻常百姓只知市井安乐，难窥江湖诡谲，唯有行走江湖之人，方能察觉这平静之下的汹涌暗潮。
“官府未曾追查？”萧琰轻声问道。
“查了，怎会不查？”老汉叹了口气，连连摇头，“京兆府的衙役日夜巡查，挨家排查，可半点线索都没有。失窃府邸皆是高墙深院，守卫森严，却一夜之间丢了物件，现场无痕无迹，绝非寻常盗贼所为。市井传言，来人武功极高，身法诡异，来去如风，根本不是凡人能及。”
萧琰默然颔首，心中已有几分思量。无痕入室、悄无声息盗取武学秘宝，绝非普通江湖蟊贼所能为，定然是受过严苛训练的江湖高手，背后必有门派势力支撑。这般势力潜入帝都隐秘行事，绝非只为些许武学残页，背后定然藏着更大的图谋。
他本是闲散江湖客，向来不问朝堂纷争、门派争斗，只求快意江湖、安稳度日。可侠者本心，便是见不平则出手，遇邪祟则制衡。若任由这股隐秘势力在帝都肆意作乱，日后必定祸患无穷，伤及无辜百姓。
正思忖间，东街尽头忽然传来一阵急促的喧哗声，打破了街巷的平和喧嚣。原本热闹的人群瞬间骚动起来，议论声、惊呼声此起彼伏，原本有序的街巷瞬间乱了几分。
萧琰抬眸望去，只见不远处人群四散奔逃，原本围看热闹的百姓纷纷避让，神色慌张。四个身着玄色劲装、面罩遮颜的汉子，手持狭长弯刀，步履凌厉，气势汹汹地沿街疾驰而过。四人身法矫健，步履沉稳，周身带着凛冽杀气，绝非寻常市井泼皮，皆是身怀武学的江湖好手。
他们行径蛮横，沿途撞翻摊铺、冲散人群，街边的水果筐、糖画炉、货郎担尽数被掀翻，瓜果滚落满地，糖稀洒落在青石板上，狼藉一片。百姓们惊惧躲闪，无人敢上前阻拦，街巷间的欢声笑语瞬间被惊恐叹息取代。
“又是他们！”茶摊老汉见状，脸色骤变，连忙低声说道，“这几日常在东街西市出没，横行霸道、肆意妄为，衙役来了便逃窜，衙役走了便作乱，无人能治！”
萧琰眸光微沉，放下手中茶碗，缓缓起身。素白衣衫在春风中微微舒展，身姿挺拔如松，周身原本温润淡然的气息，悄然凝起一抹清冽锋芒。
他本无意惹纷争，只想重游旧地、追忆往昔，安稳度过几日闲散时光。可江湖侠骨，见恶必斥，见乱必平。这般恶人在帝都闹市横行霸道、惊扰百姓，他既亲眼所见，便绝无袖手旁观之理。
四名玄衣汉子并未停留，径直冲向街巷中段的一间古玩铺。那古玩铺门面雅致，陈设精良，是东街老牌商铺，店主是一位年迈老者，半生守着这间铺子，安稳度日，素来与人为善，从不与人结怨。
此刻古玩铺门前，老者被两名玄衣汉子持刀逼退，面色惨白，身形瑟瑟发抖，却依旧死死护着身后的柜台，声音带着颤抖：“诸位好汉，老朽小店并无珍稀秘宝，唯有寻常古玩器物，还请诸位高抬贵手，放过老朽……”
为首的玄衣人身形高大，气息阴鸷，闻言冷笑一声，声音沙哑冰冷，毫无半分恻隐之心：“寻常器物？老夫听闻你铺中藏有前朝武学残篇，速速交出，否则今日便拆了你这铺子，取你性命！”
老者连连摇头，苦苦哀求：“好汉误会了！老朽一介布衣，只懂古玩鉴赏，从未接触过武学，更无什么残篇秘宝，还望好汉明察！”
“冥顽不灵！”
玄衣首领不耐呵斥一声，手腕翻转，寒光乍现，弯刀裹挟着凌厉劲风，径直朝着老者肩头劈落。刀风凛冽，杀气逼人，周遭百姓吓得失声惊呼，纷纷后退，无人敢上前阻拦。
眼看弯刀即将伤及老者，一道素白身影骤然破空而至，速度快如惊鸿掠影，无声无息便落在老者身前。
萧琰抬手，指尖轻弹，不疾不徐。
没有凌厉刀光，没有雄浑掌风，只一声清脆轻响，裹挟万钧之力的弯刀竟被他指尖精准弹开。剧烈的力道顺着刀身传导而出，玄衣首领手腕发麻，虎口剧痛，手中弯刀险些脱手飞出，整个人踉跄后退三步，满脸惊愕。

其余三名玄衣人瞬间戒备，迅速聚拢合围，四柄弯刀齐齐出鞘，寒光凛冽，杀气腾腾，死死锁定身前的萧琰。四人眼神阴狠，面色凝重，显然未曾料到这闹市之中，竟藏有这般身手卓绝的高手。
萧琰立在原地，身姿从容淡然，白衣不染半分尘埃，面对四柄利刃合围，神色依旧平静无波，不见半分慌乱。他目光淡淡扫过四人，声音清润低沉，却带着不容置喙的凛然正气，响彻喧闹街巷：“帝都闹市，朗朗乾坤，光天化日之下，持刀扰民、肆意行凶，太过放肆。”
玄衣首领稳住身形，抬眼打量萧琰，见他衣着朴素、孤身一人，看似温润无害，眼底顿时掠过一抹阴狠与不屑，冷声道：“哪来的无名野侠，也敢管我等闲事？识相的速速退去，否则连你一同斩杀！”
萧琰眸色微冷，语气依旧淡然，却多了几分凛冽：“世间闲事，唯不平事我便要管。尔等潜藏帝都，盗取秘宝、惊扰百姓、肆意行凶，已然触犯律法、悖逆侠道，今日休想再肆意妄为。”
“不知死活！”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chang'an Swordsman Xiao Shusheng 2 Main Text Chapter 96 The Hero's Shadow Leaves a Fragrance (..la) The wind of late spring passed by the end of Zhuque Street in Chang'an, turned into the narrow alley of East Street, and rolled up the scattered poplar flowers on the ground, as soft as an old dream that has not yet been awakened.
Xiao Yan stood in the center of the bluestone road, his white clothes were spotless, and an unmarked dagger hung from his waist. The scabbard was made of plain ebony, with no gilt decorations or pearls and jade embellishments. There was only a faded plain silk ribbon tied at the end of the handle, which swayed gently in the wind. He raised his eyes and looked at the endless streets and alleys in front of him. Green bricks and black tiles were arranged one after another, and the cornices pierced the light blue sky. The noisy voices of people, the wheels of carriages and horses, and the shouts of merchants were intertwined together, creating the most lively and hot fireworks scene in the imperial capital of the Tang Dynasty.
This is Chang'an where he has been away for three years.
Three years ago, he left Beijing with his sword in hand while still young. He traveled across thousands of mountains and rivers, weathered the wind and rain in the rivers and lakes, saw the miasma and smoke in southern Xinjiang, encountered the wind and snow in the north, fought through disputes in the treacherous villa, and resolved the grievances and hatreds in the rivers and lakes. Everyone knows that the rivers and lakes are vast and chivalrous, but they don't know that the rivers and lakes are far away, and every step is covered with wind and frost, and everything has its own setbacks. Now that I'm back, the imperial capital is still prosperous and bustling with traffic, but the people who traveled together in the past have long been scattered all over the world. The old grudges are buried deep in the years. Only the spring breeze in the city is as gentle as before.
East Street is not the most prosperous street in the imperial capital. It is not as grand as Zhuque Street, nor as crowded with merchants as the West Market, but it has its own gentleness and rich history. Half of the place is the daily life of ordinary people, with numerous restaurants, teahouses, and rows of stalls, mostly civilians and ordinary travelers coming and going. The other half is the atmosphere of the rivers and lakes hidden in the bustling city. Occasionally, knights with swords and swords hurried past, with wind and frost hidden in their brows and eyes, sharp edges in their steps, and hidden shadows of swords and swords.
Xiao Yan walked forward slowly. The bluestone slab under his feet had been crushed by carriages and horses and trampled by pedestrians for hundreds of years. It was warm and smooth, with fine moss and fallen flowers embedded in the gaps. He is tall and straight, walks calmly, without the arrogance of ordinary knights, his eyebrows are clear and gentle, his skin color is a light wheat color from walking in the rivers and lakes for many years, his eyes are clear and deep, seemingly indifferent, but he hides the calmness and transparency of knowing everything about the world. People in the world call him a "plain swordsman", saying that his swords are traceless, his shadow is fragrant, he treats others as gentle as jade, and he is upright and open in his dealings. But only he knows that under this gentle skin, there are many sleepless nights and many pasts that cannot bear to look back.
The stalls along the street are bustling with activity. The old man selling sugar paintings was guarding the small brass stove. The melted sugar was golden in color and dripping in strands. With a flick of his wrist, the outlines of dragons, phoenixes, flowers and birds came to life, attracting a crowd of children to gather around and watch, and their chirping laughter was clear and sweet. The flower stall opposite is filled with flowers in late spring, including graceful peonies, brilliant roses, sweet jasmine, and colorful purples all over the bamboo baskets. The fragrant flowers overflow with the wind and are crushed in the warm spring breeze. A teahouse not far away hangs a faded green cloth cover, swaying gently in the wind. The four characters "Qingfeng Teahouse" written on the cover are still clear after the wind and rain. The teahouse was buzzing with people, with people from all walks of life gathered here, chatting about trivial matters in the market, discussing rumors about the world, and a continuous flow of high and low voices.
Xiao Yan had no intention of stopping at the busy stalls or sitting down at the tea shop to chat. His gaze faintly scanned the bustling surroundings, and a hint of sadness flashed across his eyes. Three years have passed by in a blink of an eye, and everything in the world seems to be the same, but in fact things have changed. When he first entered the arena, he was full of passion and high spirits. He firmly believed that a great chivalrous person should punish evil, promote good, and uphold justice. He thought that with a short sword and a lonely body, he could sweep away the injustice in the world and protect peace every year. But after traveling around the world, I gradually understood that the world is never black and white, and people's hearts are far more unpredictable than swords. Entanglements, interests, and involuntary control have always been the norm in the world.
He walked to Laohuai in the middle of East StreetUnder the tree, stop and stand. This ancient locust tree is a hundred years old. Its branches are twisted and vigorous, its crown is as lush as clouds, and its layers of green leaves cover the sky and the sun, enveloping the surrounding world with coolness. The tree body is covered with carvings of varying depths, imprints left by decades of travelers and passers-by. Some are engraved with names, some are engraved with short sentences, and some are only blurred and mottled lines, hiding countless unknown stories.
Xiao Yan's fingertips gently brushed the rough bark, which felt slightly cool and heavy with the accumulation of time. It was here that he said goodbye to his best friend three years ago. It was also late spring, with poplar flowers in full bloom and the breeze blowing on their faces. The two leaned against the ancient locust tree, drank wine, and talked about their ideals in the world. They agreed to reunite on Chang'an East Street three years later to talk about their lives and the world together.
But now, the old place is still there, the ancient locust trees are still there, the spring breeze is still the same, but the old friend has not yet arrived.
The wind passes through the gaps in the leaves of the locust tree, rustling like an old friend's whisper, gentle and desolate. Fragments of light scattered through the branches and leaves, fell on Xiao Yan's plain white robe, and broke into dots of golden light. He lowered his eyes slightly, and the emotion in his eyes was so light that it was almost invisible. There was no sadness, no joy, no thoughts, no anger. After three years of wandering around the world, he had long since learned to let go of farewells and look down on gains and losses. When he returned to his old place, memories of the past flooded his mind, and in the end it was inevitable that he would feel a little regretful.
"Sir, would you like to take a rest? I have just brewed fresh tea before the rain. It is sweet and relieves fatigue. It costs only a penny for a bowl!"
The old man at the tea stall on the street saw him standing there for a long time, with an upright posture and extraordinary temperament, and he quickly greeted him with a smile. The old man was dressed in coarse linen clothes, with a kind face and deep wrinkles at the corners of his eyes. He held a celadon tea bowl in his hand. The tea was clear and translucent, the heat was rising, and the sweet fragrance of tea drifted in the wind.
Xiao Yan came back to his senses, nodded slightly, and thanked me softly. His voice was clear and low, with a gentle and distant feeling that had experienced the world: "Thank you very much, husband."
He walked to the wooden table of the tea stall and sat down. The wooden table and chairs were all old objects, polished smooth and moist, with the warmth of years of fireworks. The old man quickly filled a bowl of hot tea for him and said with a smile: "Looking at the guest officer's attire, he must be a knight who has traveled all over the world. It has been a long and hard journey. Thank you for your hard work. We in Chang'an East Street have not seen such an extraordinary gentleman for a long time."
Xiao Yan picked up the tea bowl and took a sip. The tea soup is clear and sweet, and the warmth slowly sinks down the throat, dispelling the fatigue from the journey. He put down the tea bowl, smiled lightly, and didn't say much. Having traveled around the world for many years, he has long been accustomed to the friendly greetings of strangers, and has also become accustomed to being silent and self-possessed, unwilling to reveal his past concerns easily.
Seeing that he didn't want to talk much, the old man didn't bother to talk. He just wiped the tables and chairs and chatted about trivial matters in the market and rumors in the streets. From the rise and fall of the East Street shops, to the recent changes in the imperial capital's scenery, and then casually chatting about the recent news circulating in the world, the words are simple and full of fireworks.
"The city of Chang'an has not been peaceful recently." The old man lowered his voice, with a hint of fear in his expression. "There have been frequent thefts in the east of the city recently. What was stolen was not gold and silver jewelry, but fragments of martial arts and strange weapons collected by various families. Normally, the government can't find any clues, but it is rumored in the market that a secret martial arts sect has sneaked into the imperial capital, secretly collecting martial arts treasures, and has evil intentions."
Xiao Yan's fingertips paused slightly, a faint edge flashed across his eyes, and he returned to calmness in an instant.
He traveled all over the world and knew that the imperial capital seemed prosperous and stable, but in fact there was an undercurrent. The forces in the court are entangled endlessly, the rivers and lakes sects are intertwined, and the battle between good and evil and the game of interests never stop. As the center of the imperial capital, Chang'an is a place where dragons and snakes are mixed, and various forces are dormant and lurking. It seems to be a peaceful and prosperous time, but secretly it has already been turbulent. Ordinary people only know that the market is peaceful and peaceful, and it is difficult to see the strangeness of the rivers and lakes. Only those who travel in the rivers and lakes can detect the turbulent undercurrents beneath this tranquility.
"Didn't the government investigate?" Xiao Yan asked softly.
"I checked, how could I not check?" The old man sighed and shook his head repeatedly, "The Yamen of Jingzhao MansionThe guards patrolled day and night and checked house to house, but there were no clues at all. The stolen mansions were all built with high walls and deep courtyards, and were heavily guarded. However, items were lost overnight, leaving no trace at all. It was definitely not the work of ordinary thieves. There are rumors in the market that this person has extremely high martial arts skills, strange movements, and moves like the wind, which is beyond the reach of ordinary people. "
Xiao Yan nodded silently, already thinking about it a bit. To break into a house without leaving a trace and steal martial arts treasures quietly is beyond the reach of ordinary thieves. He must be a master of martial arts who has received rigorous training, and there must be support from the sect behind him. Such a force sneaks into the imperial capital to act secretly, not just for some scraps of martial arts, but there must be a bigger conspiracy behind it.
He was originally an idle traveler. He never cared about court disputes or sect fighting. He only wanted to enjoy his life and live a stable life. But the true intention of a chivalrous man is to take action when he sees injustice, and to check and balance when he encounters evil spirits. If this secret force is allowed to cause wanton chaos in the imperial capital, there will be endless disasters in the future and innocent people will be harmed.
While I was thinking about it, a sudden burst of noise came from the end of East Street, breaking the peaceful hustle and bustle of the streets. The originally lively crowd instantly became commotion, with comments and exclamations coming and going, and the originally orderly streets and alleys instantly became a bit chaotic.
Xiao Yan raised his eyes and saw people running away not far away. The people who had gathered to watch the excitement all gave way and looked panicked. Four men dressed in black attire, with masks covering their faces, holding long and narrow scimitars, moved swiftly and menacingly as they galloped down the street. The four of them have strong body movements, steady steps, and a fierce murderous aura around them. They are by no means ordinary street gangsters. They are all masters of martial arts.
They acted arrogantly, knocking over stalls and scattering people along the way. Fruit baskets, sugar painting stoves, and sellers' baskets on the street were all overturned. Fruits and melons fell all over the ground, and sugar was scattered on the bluestones. It was a mess. The people hid in fear, and no one dared to step forward to stop him. The laughter and laughter in the streets were instantly replaced by sighs of horror.
"It's them again! "When the old man at the tea stall saw this, his expression suddenly changed, and he hurriedly whispered, "These past few days, I have been wandering around the East Street and West Market, acting arrogantly and recklessly. When the government officials come, I will run away, and when the government officials leave, I will cause chaos. No one can control it! "
Xiao Yan's eyes darkened slightly, he put down the teacup in his hand and stood up slowly. The plain white clothes stretched slightly in the spring breeze, and the figure was as tall and straight as a pine. The originally warm and indifferent aura around her body quietly condensed a touch of clear and sharp edge.
He had no intention of causing disputes, he just wanted to revisit old places, reminisce about the past, and spend a few days of leisure in peace. But Jianghu is a chivalrous person who will denounce evil when he sees it and put an end to chaos when he sees it. Such evil people were running rampant in the busy city of the imperial capital and disturbing the people. Since he saw it with his own eyes, he had no reason to stand by and watch.
The four men in black clothes did not stop and rushed straight to an antique shop in the middle of the street. The antique shop has an elegant facade and well-furnished furniture. It is a long-established shop on East Street. The owner is an old man. He has been keeping this shop for half his life and has lived a stable life. He has always been kind to others and never made grudges with others.
At this moment, in front of the antique shop, the old man was forced back by two men in black clothes holding knives. His face was pale and his figure was trembling, but he still guarded the counter behind him. His voice was trembling: "Heroes, there are no rare treasures in Lao Chen's shop, only ordinary antiques. Please hold your hands high and let me go..."
The leading man in Xuanyi was tall and had a sinister aura. Hearing this, he sneered, his voice was hoarse and cold, and he said without any compassion: "Ordinary artifact? I heard that there are fragments of martial arts from the previous dynasty hidden in your shop. Hand it over quickly, otherwise I will demolish your shop today and take your life! "
The old man shook his head repeatedly and begged: "Hero has misunderstood! I am an old commoner who only knows how to appreciate antiques. I have never been exposed to martial arts, and I don’t have any secret treasures. I hope the hero will notice! "
"Stubborn! "
Leader Xuanyi scolded impatiently, turned his wrist, a cold light suddenly appeared, and the scimitar was carried by the strong wind, and flew straight towards the old man's shoulder. The sword wind was fierce and murderous, and the people around him were so frightened that they lost their voices.They exclaimed and retreated, but no one dared to step forward to stop them.
Seeing that the machete was about to hurt the old man, a plain white figure suddenly came through the air, as fast as a fleeting silhouette, and landed silently in front of the old man.
Xiao Yan raised his hand and flicked his fingertips, neither fast nor slow.
There was no sharp sword light, no majestic palm wind, just a crisp and soft sound, and the scimitar carrying a huge force was accurately deflected by his fingertips. The fierce force was transmitted along the blade. Leader Xuanyi's wrist was numb and his mouth was in sharp pain. The scimitar in his hand almost flew out of his hand. He staggered back three steps with a look of shock on his face.
The remaining three men in black clothes were immediately alert and quickly gathered to surround them. The four scimitars were all unsheathed, and with a cold light and murderous intent, they locked onto Xiao Yan in front of them. The four people had sinister eyes and solemn expressions. It was obvious that they had never expected that there would be such a skilled master hidden in this busy city.
Xiao Yan stood on the spot, his posture calm and calm, his white clothes not stained by any dust. Faced with the four sharp blades surrounding him, his expression remained calm and calm, without any trace of panic. He glanced at the four people lightly, and his voice was clear and low, but with an undeniable awe and righteousness, resounding through the noisy streets: "In the busy city of the imperial capital, in the bright sky, in broad daylight, disturbing the people with a knife and committing crimes wantonly is too wanton."
Leader Xuanyi steadied his body and raised his eyes to look at Xiao Yan. Seeing that he was simply dressed, alone, and seemingly gentle and harmless, a hint of viciousness and disdain suddenly flashed across his eyes, and he said coldly: "Where is this unknown wild man who dares to meddle in my business? If you are wise, retreat quickly, or I will kill you too!"
Xiao Yan's eyes were slightly cold, and his tone was still calm, but a bit more harsh: "There are no business in the world, but I will take care of the unfair ones. You are hiding in the imperial capital, stealing secret treasures, disturbing the people, and committing crimes wantonly. You have violated the law and violated the chivalry. Don't think of doing anything wanton again today."
"I don't know whether to live or die!"
